searchText: I've set the EF Goerli validators fee receipient as the EthStaker address you posted. Please do let me know if it changes. You can see some fees being collected 😄 https://goerli.etherscan.io/address/0x4D496CcC28058B1D74B7a19541663E21154f9c84#mine ~9goETH of fees goes into the faucet every ~1h. I hope that helps slow down the burn! 😄 Maybe if other client teams are not using their Goerli funds, they can also do the same. A few more client teams taking part should do wonders for slowing down faucet depletion. Thanks! We should be good for the next few months. There are a lot of devs asking for testnet ETH. We don't have a good solution for them besides telling them to use the popular online faucets.
